def solve(case):
    import sys
    # Validate
    if not isinstance(case, dict):
        raise ValueError("case must be a dict")
    if "text" not in case:
        raise ValueError("missing text")
    if "passes" not in case:
        raise ValueError("missing passes")
    if "max_rounds" not in case:
        raise ValueError("missing max_rounds")
    text = case["text"]
    passes = case["passes"]
    max_rounds = case["max_rounds"]
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise ValueError("text must be string")
    if not isinstance(passes, list):
        raise ValueError("passes must be list")
    if not isinstance(max_rounds, int):
        raise ValueError("max_rounds must be int")
    if max_rounds < 0:
        raise ValueError("max_rounds must be non-negative")
    applications = []
    fixed_point = False
    for _ in range(max_rounds):
        changed = False
        for p in passes:
            if not isinstance(p, dict) or "name" not in p or "old" not in p or "new" not in p:
                raise ValueError("invalid pass entry")
            old = p["old"]
            new = p["new"]
            idx = text.find(old)
            if idx != -1:
                text = text[:idx] + new + text[idx+len(old):]
                applications.append(p["name"])
                changed = True
        if not changed:
            fixed_point = True
            break
    return {"applications": applications, "fixed_point": fixed_point, "text": text}
